_audit: Audit: B.7.2 (b7-2-scaffolder, Phase 3) — ai-native-rag Qwik web-public
Structural precedent: full-stack-monorepo/2.0.0/frontend/web-public/package.json.tmpl
Standard: .forge/standards/web-frontend.yaml
NEVER PUT SECRETS HERE — env values are supplied at deploy time, not committed.
vite is pinned EXACTLY to 7.3.6: vite 8.x is the npm latest but is EXCLUDED by
@builder.io/qwik peerDependencies '>=5 <8' (see README PITFALL).
Connect-ES runtime pins (^2.0.0) are owned by transport.yaml (single source of
truth). @bufbuild/protobuf is the protobuf-es v2 runtime the generated rag_pb
descriptor depends on (Connect-ES v2 retired the separate *_connect file).
WORKAROUND (t5-qwik-cli-ignore-dep, 2026-09-09): `ignore` is a devDependency
we do not import. @builder.io/qwik 1.20.0 publishes dist/cli.cjs which
require("ignore") at module-init while declaring only csstype/launch-editor/
rollup, so WITHOUT this entry every qwik subcommand dies MODULE_NOT_FOUND —
`qwik --help` included, not just `qwik build`. 1.20.0 is the npm latest, so
there is no fixed release to bump to. Pinned by web-frontend.yaml v1.2.0.
DELETE this entry once upstream declares `ignore` itself.
OVERRIDES: sharp (t7-qwik-deps-refresh, reopened 2026-09-14). @builder.io/
qwik-city 1.20.0 -> vite-imagetools 9.0.3 -> sharp 0.34.5, inside two HIGH
advisories: libvips GHSA-f88m-g3jw-g9cj (CVE-2026-33327/33328/35590/35591) and
libheif GHSA-rgj7-g3m4-5g8c. `npm audit fix --force` would DOWNGRADE qwik-city
to 1.16.1, below the pinned line, so the override lifts the transitive floor
instead. The floor is owned by web-frontend.yaml v1.3.0 (versions.sharp) and
held on every Qwik surface by b8-9 T-014. Drop it once qwik-city ships a
vite-imagetools that depends on sharp >=0.35.4 itself.
